svg.aria-label: The path we tested. The AgentForEach brain calls a Worker over HTTPS with a bearer token. The Worker routes to one Durable Object per user, which starts or restores a Firecracker microVM running our unchanged sandbox server on port 8080. Outbound HTTP and HTTPS from the microVM is intercepted and sent to an EgressPolicy Worker entrypoint, which allows listed hosts, returns 403 for everything else and injects an Authorization header. Snapshots are stored in the container registry. Raw TCP, other ports and outside DNS are blocked.
